seo.title: How Anthropic's Model Context Protocol connects AI to your data
seo.description:
Anthropic's Model Context Protocol is an open standard that connects AI assistants to your data across platforms like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive. By using servers to expose data and clients to connect, developers can build once and integrate everywhere.
